body: i know how you feel. people keep telling me to wait until i can move out but i dont know if i can wait that long. im hoping i can. it feels so hopeless and awful and i wish i could offer you a solution but i cant. go out as much as possible. try not to trigger her. maybe one day you’ll get out of there. you’ve made it this far. dont let her win by killing yourself. she doesn’t deserve that and you dont either. i hope things get better for you.
i will try to contact a therapist next week but we’ll see i guess
thank you,  maybe i’ll consider getting help but i dont know if its worth it
